builds.name: Reference: Attack-led side lane
builds.goal: Reference for Viego: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A melee reset fighter who seeks a first takedown, uses mist for approach and temporarily adopts a fallen enemy's tools. Measure getting the first takedown with Viego's own kit before possession. Borrowed abilities/items during possession cannot be mixed with all his original attacks as permanent DPS. Real attacks can exploit BotRK and Spellblade while Hullbreaker asks for side-lane pressure.
builds.summary: Real attacks can exploit BotRK and Spellblade while Hullbreaker asks for side-lane pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Viego: Measure getting the first takedown with Viego's own kit before possession. Borrowed abilities/items during possession cannot be mixed with all his original attacks as permanent DPS.

Start with the early core (BotRK or Trinity, then the other) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: None. Do not treat mana regeneration as None recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Real attacks can exploit BotRK and Spellblade while Hullbreaker asks for side-lane pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health.

Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Attack access and waves are necessary; attack items do not automatically empower every spell.

The route fails Viego's stated kit question: Measure getting the first takedown with Viego's own kit before possession. Borrowed abilities/items during possession cannot be mixed with all his original attacks as permanent DPS.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Attack access and waves are necessary; attack items do not automatically empower every spell.
Full cost 17,233 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: BotRK or Trinity, then the other. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Hullbreaker, Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: None. Do not treat mana regeneration as None recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

Viego discards any souls he is currently Possessing and teleports. On arrival he Attacks the champion with the lowest percent Health, briefly Slowing them by [99]% and dealing [((1.2) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.7) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] + [12 / 16 / 20 + (0.05) × AD[statFormula=2]]% missing Health physical damage. Other nearby enemies are Knocked Back and take [((1.2) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.7) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage.

The souls of enemy champions that die within [3] seconds of being hit by Viego become wraiths. Viego can Attack wraiths to Possess them, restoring [2 + (0.025) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.02) × AP + (5) × Stat(4)[statFormula=2] + (0.004) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]]% of enemy's max Health and gaining access to their non-ultimate Abilities, Attacks, and items for [10] seconds. During this time he replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own and gains [10]% Move Speed towards enemy champions.

Begin Charging: Viego begins gathering Mist, Slowing himself by [10]%.

Release: Viego dashes forward and hurls the gathered Mist. Deals [80 / 135 / 190 / 245 / 300 + (1) × AP] magic damage and Stuns the first enemy hit for [0.25] to [1.25] seconds based on charge time.

Passive: Viego's Attacks deal an additional [(2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / 6) × (0.01)] current Health physical damage. His first Attack against an enemy he has recently damaged with an Ability hits a second time, dealing [(0.2) × AD + (0.15) × AP] physical damage and restoring [150]% of damage dealt as Health. These bonuses are kept during Possession.

Active: Viego stabs forward, dealing [(25 / 40 / 55 / 70 / 85 + (0.7) × AD) × ((1 + ((0.6) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage.
